title: Yellow Citrusy Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: A traditional Algerian dish featuring lamb, citrus, and spices, made with lard and dairy-free friendly ingredients, resulting in a pillowy and adventurous meal.
instructions: Heat the lard and olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the lamb and cook until it is browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the lemon juice, orange juice, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Remove the tagine from the heat and let it rest, covered, for 10 minutes.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
